system.description:
• Legend of Battle: Once per day, as part of the action you use to attack, you become a force of war that lesser fighters can only dream of. Until the end of your turn:
  • All attack rolls are made with advantage
  • Every hit deals maximum damage — no rolling
  • 20th level: lasts 1 minute, and enemies that can see you must make a Will save (Class Save DC) at the start of each of their turns or be frightened for 1 round

rules.value: Legend of Battle: every hit deals maximum damage.
